purpose: Audit map for public RingRift training claims. It distinguishes claims verifiable from checked-in files from claims that require external artifacts or live operator logs.

repo_verifiable_claims.statement: hex8_2p improved from 1500.0 to 1979.8 Elo with 7 promotions.
repo_verifiable_claims.evidence_source: s3://ringrift-models-20251214/archive/gh200-8/metrics.jsonl; promotion rows are summarized in docs/RESULTS.md.

repo_verifiable_claims.statement: square8_2p improved from 1500.0 to 1782.0 Elo with 5 promotions in the checked-in snapshot.
square8_3p improved from 1500.0 to 1534.9 Elo with 1 promotion in the checked-in snapshot.
repo_verifiable_claims.evidence_source: Historical trainer metrics summarized in docs/RESULTS.md; multiplayer Elo caveat applies for pre-dfb3d20c1 estimates.

repo_verifiable_claims.statement: square8_2p iteration 34 promoted at 62.0% over 50 games to an estimated 1697.3 Elo.
square8_2p iteration 35 promoted at 62.0% over 50 games to an estimated 1782.0 Elo.
hex8_2p v3 iteration 36 rejected at 50.0% over 400 staged eval games, supporting the plateau interpretation.
hex8_3p iteration 1 rejected at 35.0%, and square8_3p iteration 21 rejected at 30.0%.

external_artifact_claims.statement: Detailed per-iteration metrics, promotion logs, and timing history require archived metrics.jsonl files.
Random is approximately 400 Elo, heuristic approximately 1200 Elo, and MCTS-medium approximately 1700 Elo as calibration context.
external_artifact_claims.artifact_location: calibration/operator context; not a new training result

external_artifact_claims.statement: Exact checkpoint replay/resume requires best.pth model files and training_data/iter_*.npz artifacts.
Training wall-time and hardware claims are operational measurements from GH200 cluster runs, not fully derivable from the checked-in repository alone.
external_artifact_claims.artifact_location: operator logs and S3 metrics archives

operator_reported_not_yet_checked_in.statement: Operator reported the hex8_2p v4 architecture experiment is live.
operator_reported_not_yet_checked_in.publication_policy: Keep this marked as an active experiment until the first completed result has durable evidence.

maintenance_policy: Update docs/data/results_snapshot.json before changing headline result numbers in README.md or docs/RESULTS.md.
Update this evidence manifest whenever a public result moves from operator-reported to repo-verifiable or external-artifact-backed.
Do not add new headline Elo claims from chat logs alone.
